parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem:
Below is a list of species which can react with organic compounds.

$$\text{CN}^- \quad \text{HCl} \quad \text{Cl} \quad \text{H}_2\text{O} \quad \text{CO}_3^{2-}$$
parts.text: From the list, identify a species which can react with ethane.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: From the list, identify **two** species which can attack the $\pi$ bond in ethene.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: From the list, identify a species which can be used to distinguish between solutions of propanoic acid and propan-1-ol. Describe any relevant observations.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Describe the conditions required for this process.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Name an organic functional group which reacts with a nucleophile in an addition reaction.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Name an organic functional group which tends to react with a nucleophile in an $\text{S}_\text{N}1$ substitution mechanism.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem:
But-1-ene reacts with steam in the presence of concentrated phosphoric acid to form two isomers of molecular formula $\text{C}_4\text{H}_{10}\text{O}$.

Each reaction occurs via a different intermediate ion.
parts.text: Draw the structure of both intermediate ions.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Circle the more stable intermediate ion drawn in **(d)(i)**. Explain your answer.
